grammar.title: 一般过去时：故事的时间
grammar.explanation: 小说和台本几乎都用过去时（past simple）来讲故事。因为故事发生在过去，动词要变成过去式。比如 propose→proposed, kneel→knelt, confess→confessed。注意不规则动词：steal→stole, feel→felt, say→said。
examples: Marshall knelt down on the kitchen floor and proposed to Lily.
He felt a warm, painful envy.
Ted stole a glance at Robin.

grammar.title: 现在进行时过去式：was/were + -ing
grammar.explanation: 小说里用 was/were + 动词-ing 来描述过去某个时刻正在进行的动作。比如「Ted was sitting at the bar when...」表示「Ted 正坐在吧台的时候...」。注意：主语 I/he/she/it 用 was，you/we/they 用 were。
examples: Ted was sitting at the bar.
His heart was pounding as he rehearsed.
They were laughing at his cheesy line.

grammar.title: 感官动词 + 形容词：look/sound/feel + adj.
grammar.explanation: 英文中，look（看起来）、sound（听起来）、feel（感觉）后面直接加形容词，不加副词。比如「He looked desperate」不说「He looked desperately」。记住规则：感官动词后面接形容词，不是副词！中考常考点。
examples: Ted felt awkward.
The ring looked beautiful.
His line sounded cheesy.

grammar.title: too...to... 结构：太...而不能...
grammar.explanation: too + 形容词/副词 + to + 动词原形，表示「太...以至于不能...」。结构本身已有否定含义，不需再加 not。中考必考句型转换：too...to... ↔ so...that...can't ↔ not...enough to...
examples: Ted was too nervous to say the right thing.
The moment was too perfect to be an accident.
He was too shy to confess his real feelings.

grammar.title: as if / as though：仿佛、好像
grammar.explanation: 表示「好像...一样」。后面可接陈述语气或虚拟语气（用过去式表示现在）。用虚拟语气时表示与事实相反。写作中增加生动感的好结构。
examples: Ted talked as if he had rehearsed for a week.
The traffic flickered as if the city were made of stars.
She looked at him as though she could see right through him.

grammar.title: Why not do...? / What about doing...?：提建议
grammar.explanation: Why not + 动词原形 = 强烈建议；What/How about + doing/noun = 温和建议。口语高频结构。
examples: Why not take a risk? Destiny never knocks twice.
What about having dinner before confessing forever?
Why not tell her how you really feel?

grammar.title: It is + adj. + for/of sb. to do：对某人来说做某事是...
grammar.explanation: 用 for 时形容词描述事情（easy, hard, important）；用 of 时形容词描述人的品质（brave, kind, stupid）。中考常考点：选 for 还是选 of？看形容词是否描述人的品格。
examples: It was brave of Ted to confess on the first night.
It was easy for Barney to make jokes about love.
It is hard for a hopeless romantic to slow down.

grammar.title: 不定式作目的状语：to + verb
grammar.explanation: to + 动词原形可以表示「为了做某事」，即目的。例如「He went to the store to buy milk」=「他去商店买牛奶」。在小说中很常见：「He decided to throw a party」=「他决定办个派对」。注意：不要和不定式作宾语混淆！
examples: Ted decided to throw a party to see Robin again.

grammar.title: 一般将来时：will + 动词原形
grammar.explanation: will + 动词原形 表示将来会发生的动作或状态。口语中常用 'll 缩写（I'll, he'll, it'll）。否定用 won't（= will not）。注意区别：be going to 强调计划和迹象；will 强调即时决定、承诺和预测。
examples: Ted will throw a party this Saturday.
He hopes she 'll show up.
The purple giraffe will hang over the sofa.

grammar.title: 形容词比较级：-er 和 more
grammar.explanation: 单音节形容词 + er（big→bigger, fast→faster）；三音节及以上用 more + 原级（more expensive, more interesting）；双音节词看结尾：以 y 结尾变 y 为 i 加 er（happy→happier），其他多用 more。注意不规则：good→better, bad→worse。
examples: Ted wanted a better excuse than just a phone call.
The party felt more important than he admitted.
Barney had a crazier plan than anyone expected.

grammar.title: so...that... / such...that...：如此...以至于...
grammar.explanation: so + 形容词/副词 + that 从句；such + (a/an) + 形容词 + 名词 + that 从句。关键区别：so 修饰形容词/副词，such 修饰名词。特例：so many/much/few/little + 名词 + that...
examples: Ted rehearsed so many times that he forgot to be natural.
It was such a cheesy line that everyone laughed.
The night was so magical that nobody wanted it to end.

grammar.title: had better / would rather：最好... / 宁愿...
grammar.explanation: had better (not) do = 最好（不）做（警告/建议）；would rather do than do = 宁愿...而不...。注意：had better 后接动词原形！
examples: "You had better slow down," Robin said.
Ted would rather confess than keep silent.
He thought: I had better not mess this up.

grammar.title: both...and... / either...or... / neither...nor...
grammar.explanation: 三个并列连词：(1) both A and B → 复数谓语；(2) either A or B → 就近一致；(3) neither A nor B → 就近一致。
examples: Both Ted and Marshall believed in true love.
She was both surprised and touched by his honesty.
Neither Ted nor Barney knew what to say.

grammar.title: the more...the more...：越...越...
grammar.explanation: the + 比较级 (+ 主谓), the + 比较级 (+ 主谓)。前一分句是条件，后一分句是结果。可以省略主谓部分。写作中表达递进因果的经典结构。
examples: The longer Ted waited, the more nervous he became.
The more he rehearsed, the less natural he sounded.
The harder you try to control love, the more it slips away.

grammar.title: 形容词 vs 名词的转换
grammar.explanation: 很多形容词加后缀变成名词：free→freedom（自由）, wise→wisdom（智慧）, happy→happiness（幸福）, possible→possibility（可能性）。这个方法帮你快速扩展词汇量！在句子中要分清：介词后、动词后、主语位置用名词；系动词后、名词前用形容词。
examples: Liberty is a noun, but liberated is an adjective.

grammar.title: 情态动词：can/could 表能力
grammar.explanation: can = 现在能够做（I can speak English）；could = 过去能够做（I could run fast when I was young）或委婉请求（Could you help me?）。can 也可以表示可能性：「It can be dangerous」。注意：could 比 can 更礼貌和不确定。
examples: Barney could find adventure anywhere.
They could barely afford the boarding passes.
What can go wrong when you have no plan?

grammar.title: 感叹句：What/How 开头
grammar.explanation: What + (a/an) + 形容词 + 名词 + 主谓！：What a beautiful night it was! How + 形容词/副词 + 主谓!：How spontaneous the plan was! 区别：What 后面接名词（带或不带形容词），How 后面接形容词或副词。中考必考！
examples: What a spontaneous plan it was!
How ridiculous the idea sounded!
What cheap boarding passes they bought!

grammar.title: Not only...but also...：不仅...而且...
grammar.explanation: 递进关系。Not only 在句首时，主谓要部分倒装（助动词提前）。写作提分利器！注意 also 有时可省略或用 as well/too 代替。
examples: Not only did Ted steal a glance, but he also rehearsed three lines.
Ted not only walked over but also blurted out his feelings.
Not only was the night perfect, but destiny also played its part.

grammar.title: whether / if：是否（名词性从句）
grammar.explanation: 两者都表示「是否」。区别：(1) whether 可用于介词后；(2) whether...or not 固定搭配；(3) whether 可导主语从句放句首。
examples: Ted didn't know whether Robin would say yes.
He wondered if the cheesy line would work.
She hadn't decided whether or not to give him a chance.

grammar.title: It's (high/about) time...：该是做某事的时候了
grammar.explanation: It's time + (that) 主语 + 过去式 = 虚拟语气（该做但还没做）；It's time + to do = 陈述语气。
examples: It was time Ted found someone. He'd been a bachelor too long.
It's high time you stopped rehearsing and just talked.
It was time to take a chance on love.

grammar.title: with + 名词 + 分词/形容词/介词短语：伴随状语
grammar.explanation: with 复合结构表示伴随状况或原因。形式：with + 名词 + doing/done/adj./prep. phrase。替代冗长从句，让句子更简洁。

grammar.explanation: 动词 + 介词构成的短语动词，意义往往不等于字面相加。例如 come across = 偶然发现，get over = 克服，put off = 推迟，take off = 起飞/脱下。注意：有些可拆分（put it off），有些不可拆分（look after the baby）。
examples: Ted came across an old red shirt in his wardrobe.
He could not get over the feeling of nostalgia.
She asked him to take off that ugly shirt.

grammar.title: 直接引语 vs 间接引语：said that...
grammar.explanation: 转述别人的话用间接引语：直接「I like you」→ 间接「He said (that) he liked me」。关键变化：(1) 时态往后退一步（现在→过去）；(2) 人称要对应；(3) 时间地点要调整（today→that day, here→there）。said 后面的 that 可省略。
examples: Ted said that the shirt brought back memories.
Robin told Ted that he should throw it away.
He said he had found the shirt behind a dusty box.

grammar.title: There be 句型过去式：There was/were
grammar.explanation: There be 表示「某地存在某物」。过去式：There was + 单数/不可数名词；There were + 复数名词。例如「There was a red shirt」=「当时有一件红衬衫」，「There were many memories」=「当时有很多回忆」。注意：be 动词的数和时态由后面的名词决定！
examples: There was a faded red shirt behind the dusty box.
There was a coffee stain on one sleeve.
There were too many memories attached to it.

grammar.title: even though / even if：即使、尽管
grammar.explanation: even though = 尽管（陈述已知事实）；even if = 即便（假设条件）。让步状语从句连词，表达「虽然...但是」的逻辑关系。写作必备。
examples: Even if the line was cheesy, Robin smiled anyway.
Even though Ted felt awkward, he kept talking.
Even if it rained, the rooftop moment was perfect.

grammar.title: should have done / shouldn't have done：本应该/本不该
grammar.explanation: 对过去的后悔或责备。should have done = 本应做（没做）；shouldn't have done = 本不该做（做了）。口语中常缩写为 should've / shouldn't've。
examples: Ted realized he should have just been himself.
He shouldn't have rehearsed three different sentences.
Maybe he should have let destiny do its work.

grammar.title: one of + 复数名词 + 单数动词：...之一
grammar.explanation: one of the + 最高级 + 复数名词 = 最...的之一。动词用单数（主语是 one，不是名词）。中国学生常犯错。
examples: This was one of the best nights of Ted's life.
Robin was one of those people you never forget.
That line became one of the most famous moments.

grammar.title: 分词短语作状语：主动-ing / 被动-ed
grammar.explanation: 现在分词(-ing)表示主动/进行；过去分词(-ed/done)表示被动/完成。分词短语的逻辑主语必须和主句主语一致。让句子更紧凑的高级写作技巧。

grammar.title: 比较级：mature vs immature
grammar.explanation: 比较级用于两个事物之间比较：(1) A is + 形容词比较级 + than B；(2) 前缀：im-/in-/un- 表示否定，例如 mature→immature。注意：不要混用 -er 和 more！常见错误：more bigger ❌ → bigger ✅
examples: Ted felt more mature than the club kids around him.
The music was louder than anything he had ever heard.
Barney was far less mature than Ted that night.

grammar.title: which 引导的定语从句
grammar.explanation: which 引导的定语从句修饰「物」或「事件」，紧跟被修饰的名词。例如「The nightclub, which Robin got them into, was famous」=「Robin 带他们进的那个夜总会有名」。which 在从句中作主语或宾语。注意：非限制性定语从句前面加逗号！
examples: The velvet rope, which the bouncer lifted, led to a VIP section.
The music, which was deafening, made Ted's chest throb.
They entered a world which none of them belonged to.

grammar.title: used to：过去常常做某事
grammar.explanation: used to + 动词原形 = 过去经常做某事（现在不做了）。否定：didn't use to / used not to。疑问：Did + 主语 + use to...? 注意：be used to + doing = 习惯于做某事（介词 to 后接 doing！）；和 used to do 完全不同！
examples: Ted used to enjoy quiet bars, not loud nightclubs.
He didn't use to feel out of place at parties.
Robin used to know all the best spots in town.

grammar.title: as...as...：和...一样... / not as...as...：不如...
grammar.explanation: as + 形容词/副词原级 + as = 同等程度；not as/so + 原级 + as = 不及。注意中间必须用原级！比较级核心考点。
examples: Ted was as nervous as a schoolboy.
The night was as magical as any fairy tale.
His line was not as clever as he thought.

grammar.title: what 引导的名词性从句：...的事情
grammar.explanation: what 可引导主语从句、宾语从句、表语从句，意思是「...的事情/东西」。what 在从句中充当主语或宾语（that 不充当成分）。写作必备结构。
examples: What Ted said surprised everyone.
What mattered most was his courage.
She never forgot what he told her on the rooftop.

grammar.title: So do I / Neither do I：我也是/我也不
grammar.explanation: So + 助动词/be + 主语 = ...也是；Neither/Nor + 助动词/be + 主语 = ...也不是。助动词要与上句一致。
examples: Ted felt nervous, and so did Robin.
Barney wasn't romantic, and neither was Ted.
Marshall believed in love, and so did his best friend.

grammar.title: 比较级 + and + 比较级：越来越...
grammar.explanation: 单音节：adj-er and adj-er（colder and colder）；多音节：more and more + 原级（more and more nervous）。
examples: The night grew colder and colder.
Ted became more and more nervous.
His voice sounded less and less confident.

grammar.title: 现在分词作伴随状语：-ing 形式
grammar.explanation: 动词-ing 可以表示伴随发生的动作，「一边...一边...」。例如「Smiling at the memory, Ted climbed to the roof」=「一边笑着回忆，Ted 一边爬上屋顶」。分词短语的逻辑主语必须和主句主语一致！常见错误：Walking home, the rain started ❌（逻辑主语不一致）

grammar.title: 不定代词：something/anything/nothing + 形容词
grammar.explanation: 不定代词（something, anything, nothing, someone, anyone 等）的修饰形容词要后置！例如：something cold（冷的东西）✓，cold something ❌。anything 用于否定和疑问；nothing = not...anything。中考重点考点。
examples: Ted felt something special about that Halloween night.
Was there anything strange about the girl in the costume?
Nothing important happened after she disappeared.

grammar.title: too...to... 结构：太...而不能...
grammar.explanation:
too + 形容词/副词 + to + 动词原形，表示「太...以至于不能...」。结构本身含有否定含义，不需要再加 not。例如「He was too nervous to speak」=「他太紧张了说不出话」。中考常考句型转换：too...to... ↔ so...that...can't
↔ not...enough to...
examples: Ted was too shy to ask for her number that night.
The memory was too vivid to forget.
Four years later, he was still too hopeful to give up.

grammar.title: enough to do sth：足够...可以做某事
grammar.explanation: 形容词/副词 + enough + to do，表示达到足够程度。与 too...to... 相反：brave enough to speak ↔ too shy to speak。注意 enough 的位置：形容词后（good enough）、名词前（enough time）。
examples: Ted was brave enough to walk over and introduce himself.
Was the line clever enough to impress her?
He wasn't confident enough to skip rehearsing.

grammar.title: by the time：到...的时候
grammar.explanation: 表示「到某个时间点为止」。主句常用完成时。过去完成时的重要触发词！by the time + 过去时间点 → 主句用过去完成时。
examples: By the time Ted arrived, Robin had already left.
By the time the night ended, everything had changed.
By the time he confessed, she had guessed.

grammar.title: 间接疑问句：陈述语序（不倒装）
grammar.explanation: 直接问句转间接引语时用陈述语序。关键：He asked where she was（不是 He asked where was she）。中考必考！

grammar.title: 现在完成时：从过去到现在

examples: Ted has filled out a questionnaire with ninety questions.

grammar.title: Not only...but also...：不仅...而且...
grammar.explanation: 表示递进。Not only 在句首时，后面主谓要倒装：Not only did he..., but he also...。正常语序：He not only did X but also did Y。写作中代替 and 能提升表达层次。注意：but also 后面接和 not only 后面对称的结构。
examples: Not only did Ted fill out the questionnaire, but he also believed in the results.

grammar.title: 被动语态：be + 过去分词
grammar.explanation: be + 过去分词（done），表示主语是动作的承受者。主动→被动转换：宾语变主语，动词变 be done，主语变 by + 宾语。什么时候用被动？(1) 不知道动作执行者；(2) 不关心执行者；(3) 不想说出执行者；(4) 客观描述。
examples: Ted was given a questionnaire with ninety questions.

The perfect match was chosen by a computer.

grammar.title: If only... / I wish...：但愿...（虚拟语气）
grammar.explanation: 对现在的愿望用过去式；对过去的后悔用 had done。表达强烈情感。If only 比 I wish 语气更强烈、更书面。
examples: If only Ted had known what to say!
I wish the night could last forever.
If only destiny would give him a sign.

grammar.title: 关系副词 where/when/why 引导定语从句
grammar.explanation: where = in/at which（地点）；when = at/on which（时间）；why = for which（原因）。关系副词在从句中作状语。

The reason why he never forgot was simple.

grammar.title: need doing / need to be done：需要被...
grammar.explanation: need doing = need to be done，主动形式表被动含义。The room needs cleaning = The room needs to be cleaned。中国学生易错点！

grammar.title: 感官动词 + 形容词
grammar.explanation: 感官动词 look, sound, smell, taste, feel 后面接形容词（描述主语的状态），不是副词。这与中文思维不同！因为你描述的是一件东西给人的感觉，而不是动作的方式。比如：The turkey smells delicious（火鸡闻起来很香），不是 deliciously。
examples: The roasted bird smelled delicious.

grammar.title: 频度副词：always/never/sometimes/often
grammar.explanation: 频度副词表示动作发生的频率，位置规则：(1) be 动词后（He is always late）；(2) 普通动词前（She never eats meat）；(3) 助动词和主动词之间（He has always loved her）。sometimes 可以放句首。频率排序：always(100%) > usually > often > sometimes > seldom > never(0%)。
examples: His mother always roasted a bird the size of a dog.
Lily never felt comfortable with the in-laws.
Thanksgiving dinner often turned into an adventure.

grammar.title: 动名词作主语/宾语：动词-ing 当名词用
grammar.explanation: 动词-ing 形式可以当名词使用：(1) 作主语：Smoking is bad for you；(2) 作宾语：I enjoy reading；(3) 作介词宾语：He's good at cooking。注意区别不定式：动名词强调动作本身/一般情况，不定式强调具体一次/将来目的。
examples: Meeting the in-laws was a terrifying experience.
Marshall dreaded bringing Lily home for Thanksgiving.
There was no escaping the family traditions.

grammar.title: too...to... 结构：太...而不能...
grammar.explanation: too + 形容词/副词 + to + 动词原形，表示「太...以至于不能...」。结构本身已有否定含义，不需再加 not。中考必考句型转换：too...to... ↔ so...that...can't ↔ not...enough to...
examples: Ted was too nervous to say the right thing.
The moment was too perfect to be an accident.
He was too shy to confess his real feelings.

grammar.title: so...that... / such...that...：如此...以至于...
grammar.explanation: so + 形容词/副词 + that 从句；such + (a/an) + 形容词 + 名词 + that 从句。关键区别：so 修饰形容词/副词，such 修饰名词。特例：so many/much/few/little + 名词 + that...
examples: Ted rehearsed so many times that he forgot to be natural.
It was such a cheesy line that everyone laughed.
The night was so magical that nobody wanted it to end.

grammar.title: 情态动词 + be done：含情态的被动语态
grammar.explanation: 公式：情态动词 + be + 过去分词。can be done（可被做）、should be done（应被做）、must be done（必须被做）。
examples: Love can be found in the most unexpected places.

grammar.title: 不规则动词过去式复习
grammar.explanation: 不规则动词过去式没有固定规律，必须逐个记忆！本集重点：wake→woke, drink→drank, recall→recalled（规则）, fall→fell, know→knew。技巧：(1) 分组记忆（AAA型：cut-cut-cut；ABB型：feel-felt-felt；ABC型：drink-drank-drunk）；(2) 建立句子联想。
examples: Ted woke up with a terrible hangover.

grammar.title: 条件状语从句：if + 一般现在时, will + 动词原形
grammar.explanation: 第一类条件句（真实条件）：if + 主语 + 一般现在时，主语 + will/can/may + 动词原形。表示「如果...就会...」。注意：if 从句中不能用 will！常见错误：If it will rain ❌ → If it rains ✅。unless = if...not。
examples: If Ted remembers what happened, he will explain the pineapple.
If anyone knows the story, it will probably be Barney.
Unless he finds the truth, the mystery will remain.

grammar.title: 反身代词：myself/yourself/himself 等
grammar.explanation: 反身代词表示动作回到自己身上。用法：(1) 作宾语：He hurt himself；(2) 作同位语强调：I made it myself。列表：myself, yourself, himself, herself, itself, ourselves, yourselves, themselves。注意：英文中有些动词必须用反身代词（enjoy oneself, behave oneself）。
examples: Ted asked himself how the pineapple got there.
He should have controlled himself better at the bar.
The group found themselves in a ridiculous situation.

grammar.title: Not only...but also...：不仅...而且...
grammar.explanation: 递进关系。Not only 在句首时，主谓要部分倒装（助动词提前）。写作提分利器！注意 also 有时可省略或用 as well/too 代替。
examples: Not only did Ted steal a glance, but he also rehearsed three lines.
Ted not only walked over but also blurted out his feelings.
Not only was the night perfect, but destiny also played its part.

grammar.title: as if / as though：仿佛、好像
grammar.explanation: 表示「好像...一样」。后面可接陈述语气或虚拟语气（用过去式表示现在）。用虚拟语气时表示与事实相反。写作中增加生动感的好结构。
examples: Ted talked as if he had rehearsed for a week.
The traffic flickered as if the city were made of stars.
She looked at him as though she could see right through him.

grammar.title: even though / even if：即使、尽管
grammar.explanation: even though = 尽管（陈述已知事实）；even if = 即便（假设条件）。让步状语从句连词，表达「虽然...但是」的逻辑关系。写作必备。
examples: Even if the line was cheesy, Robin smiled anyway.
Even though Ted felt awkward, he kept talking.
Even if it rained, the rooftop moment was perfect.

grammar.title: So do I / Neither do I：我也是/我也不
grammar.explanation: So + 助动词/be + 主语 = ...也是；Neither/Nor + 助动词/be + 主语 = ...也不是。助动词要与上句一致。

grammar.title: 间接引语：转述别人的话
grammar.explanation: 转述别人的话时，要做三个变化：(1) 人称：I → he/she, we → they；(2) 时态后退一步：现在→过去，过去→过去完成；(3) 时间词：now→then, today→that day, tomorrow→the next day。said 后面 that 可省略（口语）。
examples: Barney said (that) New Year's Eve was the most important night.
The chauffeur told them that he had seen every kind of foolish night.
Ted explained that he had planned five parties.

grammar.title: 直接引语 vs 间接引语：said that...
grammar.explanation: 直接引语：用引号原封不动引用。间接引语：用自己的话转述。变化规则同上。特别注意疑问句转为间接引语时用陈述语序：He asked where she was（不是 He asked where was she）。
examples: "I have a schedule of five parties," Ted said.
Ted said that he had a schedule of five parties.
Barney asked when the limousine would arrive.

grammar.title: There be 句型过去式：There was/were
grammar.explanation: There was + 单数名词 + 地点/时间；There were + 复数名词 + 地点/时间。表示「过去某处有...」。描述故事场景的必备句型！注意：be 动词的单复数由紧跟在后的第一个名词决定（就近原则）。
examples: There was a white limousine waiting outside.
There were five parties on Ted's schedule.
There was champagne and laughter in the car.

grammar.title: should have done / shouldn't have done：本应该/本不该
grammar.explanation: 对过去的后悔或责备。should have done = 本应做（没做）；shouldn't have done = 本不该做（做了）。口语中常缩写为 should've / shouldn't've。
examples: Ted realized he should have just been himself.
He shouldn't have rehearsed three different sentences.
Maybe he should have let destiny do its work.

grammar.title: must have done / can't have done：肯定/不可能（推测过去）
grammar.explanation: 对过去的推测。must have done = 肯定做了（90%把握）；can't/couldn't have done = 不可能做了。注意：表推测时 must 只用于肯定句，否定用 can't。
examples: Robin must have noticed the ring on Lily's finger.
Ted must have been incredibly nervous.
She can't have known what he was about to say.

grammar.title: by the time：到...的时候
grammar.explanation: 表示「到某个时间点为止」。主句常用完成时。过去完成时的重要触发词！by the time + 过去时间点 → 主句用过去完成时。
examples: By the time Ted arrived, Robin had already left.
By the time the night ended, everything had changed.
By the time he confessed, she had guessed.

grammar.title: It is + adj. + for/of sb. to do：对某人来说做某事是...
grammar.explanation: 用 for 时形容词描述事情（easy, hard, important）；用 of 时形容词描述人的品质（brave, kind, stupid）。中考常考点：选 for 还是选 of？看形容词是否描述人的品格。
examples: It was brave of Ted to confess on the first night.
It was easy for Barney to make jokes about love.
It is hard for a hopeless romantic to slow down.

grammar.title: 情态动词：can/could/must/should
grammar.explanation: 情态动词 + 动词原形：(1) can=能/可以; could=能(过去)/委婉请求; (2) must=必须/肯定(推测); (3) should=应该(建议); (4) may=可能/可以(许可)。注意：情态动词没有人称变化，没有不定式（不能说 to must）。mustn't=禁止（不是「不必」！不必=don't have to/needn't）。
examples: Ted must find a plus-one for the wedding.
He should have asked Robin earlier.
He could not pretend it meant nothing forever.

grammar.title: which 引导的定语从句
grammar.explanation: which 修饰前面的名词（通常是物/事件），在从句中作主语或宾语。非限制性定语从句（有逗号）用于补充说明，去掉后句子仍完整；限制性定语从句（无逗号）用于限定范围，去掉后意思不清楚。
examples: The invitation card, which asked for a plus-one, arrived on Tuesday.
The wedding which Ted attended changed everything.
He asked Robin, which was both brave and foolish.

grammar.title: used to：过去常常做某事
grammar.explanation: used to + 动词原形 = 过去常做（现在不做了）。否定：didn't use to / used not to。疑问：Did + 主语 + use to...? 关键区别：be used to + doing/noun = 习惯做某事；get used to + doing = 变得习惯。to 是介词！
examples: Ted used to think weddings were simple.
He didn't use to worry about plus-ones.
The invitation made him feel things he used to ignore.

grammar.title: both...and... / either...or... / neither...nor...
grammar.explanation: 三个并列连词：(1) both A and B → 复数谓语；(2) either A or B → 就近一致；(3) neither A nor B → 就近一致。
examples: Both Ted and Marshall believed in true love.
She was both surprised and touched by his honesty.
Neither Ted nor Barney knew what to say.

grammar.title: whether / if：是否（名词性从句）
grammar.explanation: 两者都表示「是否」。区别：(1) whether 可用于介词后；(2) whether...or not 固定搭配；(3) whether 可导主语从句放句首。
examples: Ted didn't know whether Robin would say yes.
He wondered if the cheesy line would work.
She hadn't decided whether or not to give him a chance.

grammar.title: had better / would rather：最好... / 宁愿...
grammar.explanation: had better (not) do = 最好（不）做（警告/建议）；would rather do than do = 宁愿...而不...。注意：had better 后接动词原形！
examples: "You had better slow down," Robin said.
Ted would rather confess than keep silent.
He thought: I had better not mess this up.

grammar.title: what 引导的名词性从句：...的事情
grammar.explanation: what 可引导主语从句、宾语从句、表语从句，意思是「...的事情/东西」。what 在从句中充当主语或宾语（that 不充当成分）。写作必备结构。
examples: What Ted said surprised everyone.
What mattered most was his courage.
She never forgot what he told her on the rooftop.

grammar.title: It's (high/about) time...：该是做某事的时候了
grammar.explanation: It's time + (that) 主语 + 过去式 = 虚拟语气（该做但还没做）；It's time + to do = 陈述语气。
examples: It was time Ted found someone. He'd been a bachelor too long.
It's high time you stopped rehearsing and just talked.
It was time to take a chance on love.

grammar.title: 定语从句：who / which / that
grammar.explanation: 关系代词引导定语从句，修饰前面的名词（先行词）。who 修饰人，which 修饰物，that 修饰人或物（更口语化）。在从句中：(1) 作主语时不能省略；(2) 作宾语时可省略。例如：The girl (who/that) Ted saw across the room was Victoria。
examples: There was a drumroll from the band that played in the corner.
Ted saw a woman who captivated him instantly.
The chemistry which they shared was electric.

grammar.title: 不定代词：something/anything/nothing + 形容词
grammar.explanation: 不定代词（something, anything, nothing, someone 等）的修饰形容词必须后置：something special（特殊的东西）。anything 用于否定和疑问句；nothing = not...anything。这是中国学生错误率最高的语法点之一。
examples: Ted felt something magical in the air that night.
Was there anything real behind the drumroll?
Nothing ordinary happened after their eyes met.

grammar.title: too...to... 结构：太...而不能...
grammar.explanation: too + 形容词/副词 + to do，含有否定含义。可与 so...that...can't 互相转换：The music was too loud to hear → The music was so loud that no one could hear。与 enough to 相反：too young to drive ↔ old enough to drive。
examples: The moment was too perfect to be an accident.
Ted was too captivated to walk away.
Their connection was too strong to ignore.

grammar.title: as...as...：和...一样... / not as...as...：不如...
grammar.explanation: as + 形容词/副词原级 + as = 同等程度；not as/so + 原级 + as = 不及。注意中间必须用原级！比较级核心考点。
examples: Ted was as nervous as a schoolboy.
The night was as magical as any fairy tale.
His line was not as clever as he thought.

grammar.title: the more...the more...：越...越...
grammar.explanation: the + 比较级 (+ 主谓), the + 比较级 (+ 主谓)。前一分句是条件，后一分句是结果。可以省略主谓部分。写作中表达递进因果的经典结构。
examples: The longer Ted waited, the more nervous he became.
The more he rehearsed, the less natural he sounded.
The harder you try to control love, the more it slips away.

grammar.title: 比较级 + and + 比较级：越来越...
grammar.explanation: 单音节：adj-er and adj-er（colder and colder）；多音节：more and more + 原级（more and more nervous）。
examples: The night grew colder and colder.
Ted became more and more nervous.
His voice sounded less and less confident.

grammar.title: with + 名词 + 分词/形容词/介词短语：伴随状语
grammar.explanation: with 复合结构表示伴随状况或原因。形式：with + 名词 + doing/done/adj./prep. phrase。替代冗长从句，让句子更简洁。
examples: With his heart pounding, Ted walked across the bar.
With the ring sparkling, Lily couldn't stop smiling.
With rain in her hair, Robin looked unforgettable.

grammar.title: 现在完成进行时：have been + -ing
grammar.explanation: have/has been + 动词-ing，表示从过去开始一直持续到现在的动作，强调「一直在做」。和现在完成时的区别：完成时强调结果，完成进行时强调持续过程。标志词：for/since + 时间段，all day/week, recently。
examples: Marshall and Lily have been hiding in the bedroom for hours.

grammar.title: Not only...but also...：不仅...而且...
grammar.explanation: 第二次接触这个结构（第一次在 EP07）。本集重点：not only 在句首的倒装加强练习。Not only were they trapped, but they also became hostages。写作评分标准中，正确使用倒装句是加分项！
examples: Not only were Marshall and Lily trapped, but they also became hostages.

grammar.title: 被动语态：be + 过去分词
grammar.explanation: 第三次接触被动语态（前两次 EP07/08）。本集重点：在不同时态下使用被动：is/was done, is being done, has been done。例如：They were trapped → They had been trapped → They are being held hostage。
examples: Marshall and Lily were trapped in the bedroom.
The mood would be killed if they walked out.
They had been forced to become hostages in their own flat.

grammar.title: If only... / I wish...：但愿...（虚拟语气）
grammar.explanation: 对现在的愿望用过去式；对过去的后悔用 had done。表达强烈情感。If only 比 I wish 语气更强烈、更书面。
examples: If only Ted had known what to say!
I wish the night could last forever.
If only destiny would give him a sign.

grammar.title: enough to do sth：足够...可以做某事
grammar.explanation: 形容词/副词 + enough + to do，表示达到足够程度。与 too...to... 相反：brave enough to speak ↔ too shy to speak。注意 enough 的位置：形容词后（good enough）、名词前（enough time）。
examples: Ted was brave enough to walk over and introduce himself.
Was the line clever enough to impress her?
He wasn't confident enough to skip rehearsing.

grammar.title: Only + 状语放句首的倒装：只有当...才...
grammar.explanation: Only + 副词/介词短语/状语从句放句首时，主句用部分倒装（助动词提前）。表示强调条件。高级句式。

grammar.title: 过去将来时：would + 动词原形
grammar.explanation: would + 动词原形，表示从过去的角度看将来会发生的事。常见于宾语从句（He said he would come）和故事叙述中。和 will 的区别：will 从现在的角度谈将来；would 从过去的角度谈将来。也称为「过去的将来」。
examples: Ted found a hat that would suit him perfectly.
He didn't know this Tuesday would become perfect.
A stranger would change his perspective on life.

grammar.title: 频度副词：always/never/sometimes/often
grammar.explanation: 第二次接触（第一次 EP09）。复习位置规则：be 动词后，普通动词前。注意事项：频度副词不能和频率短语连用（不能说 sometimes twice a week，只能说 twice a week）。always 表示频繁程度比中文的「总是」要低。
examples: Ordinary Tuesdays never felt special.
Ted always rushed through his mornings.
He sometimes forgot how simple happiness could be.

grammar.title: 动名词作主语/宾语：动词-ing 当名词用
grammar.explanation: 第二次接触（第一次 EP09）。重点复习动名词作主语的用法。注意：动名词作主语时，谓语动词用单数！例如：Meeting a stranger is...（不是 are）。不定式也可作主语但更正式，动名词更口语化。
examples: Buying a cupcake from the bakery felt like an act of kindness.
Finding a hat that suited him was pure luck.
He loved walking without a destination.

grammar.title: Why not do...? / What about doing...?：提建议
grammar.explanation: Why not + 动词原形 = 强烈建议；What/How about + doing/noun = 温和建议。口语高频结构。
examples: Why not take a risk? Destiny never knocks twice.
What about having dinner before confessing forever?
Why not tell her how you really feel?

grammar.title: one of + 复数名词 + 单数动词：...之一
grammar.explanation: one of the + 最高级 + 复数名词 = 最...的之一。动词用单数（主语是 one，不是名词）。中国学生常犯错。
examples: This was one of the best nights of Ted's life.
Robin was one of those people you never forget.
That line became one of the most famous moments.

grammar.title: 间接疑问句：陈述语序（不倒装）
grammar.explanation: 直接问句转间接引语时用陈述语序。关键：He asked where she was（不是 He asked where was she）。中考必考！
examples: Ted asked himself what he should say.
He wondered where she came from.
Barney asked why Ted looked so nervous.

grammar.title: no sooner...than... / hardly...when...：刚...就...
grammar.explanation: 主句过去完成时，从句一般过去时。no sooner/hardly 放句首时主句倒装。高级写作结构。

grammar.title: 虚拟语气：If I were...
grammar.explanation: 与现在事实相反的假设用虚拟语气：If I were you, I would...（注意：I 后用 were 不是 was！）。公式：If + 主语 + 过去式，主语 + would/could/might + 动词原形。表示「如果...的话，就会...」，但事实上不是这样。
examples: If Marshall were an anthropologist, he would observe them.
"I am not an employee," he said. "If I were, I'd act differently."
If his colleagues knew he was documenting them, they would be furious.

grammar.title: 条件状语从句：if + 一般现在时, will + 动词原形
grammar.explanation: 第二次接触第一类条件句（第一次 EP10）。真实条件句：if + 现在时，主句用将来时。注意和虚拟语气的区别：真实条件（可能发生）用现在时；虚拟条件（不可能/假设）用过去式。
examples: If Marshall documents everything, he will understand the company culture.
If his colleagues find the notebook, the situation will turn awkward.
If you observe long enough, patterns will emerge.

grammar.title: 反身代词：myself/yourself/himself 等
grammar.explanation: 第二次接触反身代词（第一次 EP10）。重点：作同位语强调用法——名词/代词 + 反身代词，表示「亲自、本人」。例如：I made it myself = 我自己做的。和宾语用法的区别：He saw himself（宾语） vs He himself saw it（同位语强调）
examples: Marshall considered himself a scientist, not an employee.
He told himself he was just observing.
The colleagues themselves had no idea they were being studied.

grammar.title: too...to... 结构：太...而不能...
grammar.explanation: too + 形容词/副词 + to + 动词原形，表示「太...以至于不能...」。结构本身已有否定含义，不需再加 not。中考必考句型转换：too...to... ↔ so...that...can't ↔ not...enough to...
examples: Ted was too nervous to say the right thing.
The moment was too perfect to be an accident.
He was too shy to confess his real feelings.

grammar.title: so...that... / such...that...：如此...以至于...
grammar.explanation: so + 形容词/副词 + that 从句；such + (a/an) + 形容词 + 名词 + that 从句。关键区别：so 修饰形容词/副词，such 修饰名词。特例：so many/much/few/little + 名词 + that...
examples: Ted rehearsed so many times that he forgot to be natural.
It was such a cheesy line that everyone laughed.
The night was so magical that nobody wanted it to end.

grammar.title: even though / even if：即使、尽管
grammar.explanation: even though = 尽管（陈述已知事实）；even if = 即便（假设条件）。让步状语从句连词，表达「虽然...但是」的逻辑关系。写作必备。
examples: Even if the line was cheesy, Robin smiled anyway.
Even though Ted felt awkward, he kept talking.
Even if it rained, the rooftop moment was perfect.

grammar.title: a number of vs the number of：许多 vs ...的数量
grammar.explanation: a number of + 复数名词 + 复数动词 = 许多；the number of + 复数名词 + 单数动词 = ...的数量。中考经典考点。
examples: A number of friends were at the bar.
The number of times Ted rehearsed was ridiculous.
A number of things went wrong, but everything went right.

grammar.title: 介词 + which/whom 引导的定语从句
grammar.explanation: 正式英语中，介词可提到关系代词前。for whom, in which, to which 等。写作中提升正式度的好结构。

grammar.title: should have / shouldn't have：后悔
grammar.explanation: should have done = 本应该做（但没做）；shouldn't have done = 本不该做（但做了）。这是表达后悔最常用的结构。注意：have 后面接过去分词！常见错误：should had done ❌ → should have done ✅。口语中常缩写成 should've。
examples: Ted should have gone to bed before two.
He shouldn't have stayed up that late.
Lily should have warned him more forcefully.

grammar.title: 直接引语 vs 间接引语：said that...
grammar.explanation: 第三次接触（前两次 EP04/11）。本集重点：转述警告和建议。Lily had a rule, and she warned Ted about it often。注意 warn/tell/advise 后面既可以接 that 从句，也可以接 to do：She warned him (that) he should sleep 或 She warned him to sleep early。
examples: Lily warned Ted that nothing good happens after two.
She told him that insomnia was dangerous.
Ted admitted that he should have listened.

grammar.title: There be 句型过去式：There was/were
grammar.explanation: 第三次接触（前两次 EP04/11）。本集重点：用 There was/were 营造深夜街头的寂静氛围。注意：描述环境/场景时，There be 比直接描述更自然。例如 There was nobody on the street 比 The street had nobody 更地道。
examples: There was nobody on the street below.
There was only a buzzing streetlamp.
There were no cars, no voices, no signs of life.

grammar.title: must have done / can't have done：肯定/不可能（推测过去）
grammar.explanation: 对过去的推测。must have done = 肯定做了（90%把握）；can't/couldn't have done = 不可能做了。注意：表推测时 must 只用于肯定句，否定用 can't。
examples: Robin must have noticed the ring on Lily's finger.
Ted must have been incredibly nervous.
She can't have known what he was about to say.

grammar.title: as if / as though：仿佛、好像
grammar.explanation: 表示「好像...一样」。后面可接陈述语气或虚拟语气（用过去式表示现在）。用虚拟语气时表示与事实相反。写作中增加生动感的好结构。
examples: Ted talked as if he had rehearsed for a week.
The traffic flickered as if the city were made of stars.
She looked at him as though she could see right through him.

grammar.title: by the time：到...的时候
grammar.explanation: 表示「到某个时间点为止」。主句常用完成时。过去完成时的重要触发词！by the time + 过去时间点 → 主句用过去完成时。
examples: By the time Ted arrived, Robin had already left.
By the time the night ended, everything had changed.
By the time he confessed, she had guessed.

grammar.title: So do I / Neither do I：我也是/我也不
grammar.explanation: So + 助动词/be + 主语 = ...也是；Neither/Nor + 助动词/be + 主语 = ...也不是。助动词要与上句一致。
examples: Ted felt nervous, and so did Robin.

grammar.title: 使役动词：make / let / have
grammar.explanation: 使役动词 + 宾语 + 动词原形：(1) make sb. do = 让/迫使某人做（强制性）；(2) let sb. do = 让/允许某人做（许可）；(3) have sb. do = 让某人做（安排/吩咐）。注意区别：make sb. do vs be made to do（被动要加 to！）；let 和 allow 的区别：let + do, allow + to do。
examples: Barney made everyone believe the woman was a paralegal.
Ted let the rumour take root in his head.
Barney had Ted assume the worst.

grammar.title: which 引导的定语从句
grammar.explanation: 第三次接触 which 定语从句（前两次 EP05/12）。本集重点：which 在非限制性定语从句中充当宾语，修饰前面整个事件或情况。例如：Barney winked twice, which started the rumour。这里 which 修饰的是「Barney 眨眼两次」这件事。
examples: Barney winked twice, which started a stupid rumour.
The dinner, which was supposed to be formal, turned awkward.
Ted believed the lie, which was exactly what Barney wanted.

grammar.title: used to：过去常常做某事
grammar.explanation: 第三次接触 used to（前两次 EP05/12）。综合复习：used to do（过去常做）vs be used to doing（习惯做）vs get used to doing（变得习惯）。本集可以练习三者之间的转换，尤其是语境判断。
examples: Ted used to trust Barney without question.
He wasn't used to questioning his friend's stories.
He never got used to being the target of Barney's jokes.

grammar.title: Not only...but also...：不仅...而且...
grammar.explanation: 递进关系。Not only 在句首时，主谓要部分倒装（助动词提前）。写作提分利器！注意 also 有时可省略或用 as well/too 代替。
examples: Not only did Ted steal a glance, but he also rehearsed three lines.
Ted not only walked over but also blurted out his feelings.
Not only was the night perfect, but destiny also played its part.

grammar.title: get + 过去分词：口语被动
grammar.explanation: 口语中用 get done 代替 be done，强调突发/意外。get married, get lost, get caught 都是高频用法。
examples: Ted got caught in the rain.
Marshall and Lily got married.
He got lost in the moment.

grammar.title: It is + adj. + for/of sb. to do：对某人来说做某事是...
grammar.explanation: 用 for 时形容词描述事情（easy, hard, important）；用 of 时形容词描述人的品质（brave, kind, stupid）。中考常考点：选 for 还是选 of？看形容词是否描述人的品格。
examples: It was brave of Ted to confess on the first night.
It was easy for Barney to make jokes about love.
It is hard for a hopeless romantic to slow down.

grammar.explanation: 现在分词(-ing)表示主动/进行；过去分词(-ed/done)表示被动/完成。分词短语的逻辑主语必须和主句主语一致。让句子更紧凑的高级写作技巧。

grammar.explanation: would + 动词原形，和 used to 一样表示过去习惯性动作。区别：(1) would 只能用于动作动词，不能用于状态动词（不能说 He would be tall）；(2) would 更文学化、更叙事性；(3) used to 强调「现在不了」，would 强调「过去常常」。
examples: Every night Ted would stare at the ceiling, thinking about her.

grammar.title: 不定代词：something/anything/nothing + 形容词
grammar.explanation: 第三次接触不定代词（前两次 EP06/13）。重点复习形容词后置规则，并扩展到 someone/anyone/no one + 形容词。本集进阶：不定代词 + 形容词 + to do 结构，例如 something special to remember。
examples: They dressed in something ridiculous for the prom.

grammar.title: too...to... 结构：太...而不能...
grammar.explanation: 第三次接触 too...to...（前两次 EP06/13）。本集综合练习：too...to... ↔ so...that... ↔ enough to... 三种结构的互相转换。通常中考会出句型转换题。例如：They were too old to fit in ↔ They were so old that they couldn't fit in ↔ They weren't young enough to fit in。
examples: They were too old to fit in at a high-school prom.
The disguise was too poor to fool anyone.
Barney was too determined to give up on hearing the band.

grammar.title: had better / would rather：最好... / 宁愿...
grammar.explanation: had better (not) do = 最好（不）做（警告/建议）；would rather do than do = 宁愿...而不...。注意：had better 后接动词原形！
examples: "You had better slow down," Robin said.
Ted would rather confess than keep silent.

grammar.title: what 引导的名词性从句：...的事情
grammar.explanation: what 可引导主语从句、宾语从句、表语从句，意思是「...的事情/东西」。what 在从句中充当主语或宾语（that 不充当成分）。写作必备结构。
examples: What Ted said surprised everyone.
What mattered most was his courage.
She never forgot what he told her on the rooftop.

grammar.title: If only... / I wish...：但愿...（虚拟语气）
grammar.explanation: 对现在的愿望用过去式；对过去的后悔用 had done。表达强烈情感。If only 比 I wish 语气更强烈、更书面。
examples: If only Ted had known what to say!
I wish the night could last forever.
If only destiny would give him a sign.

grammar.title: with + 名词 + 分词/形容词/介词短语：伴随状语
grammar.explanation: with 复合结构表示伴随状况或原因。形式：with + 名词 + doing/done/adj./prep. phrase。替代冗长从句，让句子更简洁。

With rain in her hair, Robin looked unforgettable.

grammar.title: 比喻与类比（metaphor & analogy）
grammar.explanation: 比喻是用一种事物形容另一种事物，不说「像」而是「是」。例如「The milk was an omen」=「那盒牛奶是个征兆」。类比是用一个熟悉的情境解释一个不熟悉的道理。写作高级技巧：善用比喻让抽象概念变具体，让普通叙述变生动。
examples: The milk carton was an omen — not sour yet, but soon.
His life felt like a carton of milk with an expiry date.
Ted stared at the fridge as if it held the answer to his future.

grammar.title: Not only...but also...：不仅...而且...
grammar.explanation: 第四次接触（前三次 EP07/10/14）。本集达到熟练掌握程度。练习：用 Not only...but also... 写关于时间流逝、成长和改变的句子。注意倒装和非倒装两种形式的灵活切换。
examples: Not only was Ted turning twenty-eight, but he also felt life passing by.
The milk not only had an expiry date but also seemed to mock him.
Not only did he check the date, but he also sniffed the carton.

grammar.title: 被动语态：be + 过去分词
grammar.explanation: 第四次接触被动语态（前三次 EP07/08/14）。本集达到熟练掌握程度。综合练习：在不同语境和时态中使用被动语态。重点：什么时候该用被动？当动作的承受者比执行者更重要时。例如：The date was printed on the carton（日期被印在盒子上）。
examples: Ted was reminded of his own mortality by a carton of milk.
The expiry date was printed in bold black letters.
His birthday has been chosen by fate as the deadline.

grammar.title: It's (high/about) time...：该是做某事的时候了
grammar.explanation: It's time + (that) 主语 + 过去式 = 虚拟语气（该做但还没做）；It's time + to do = 陈述语气。
examples: It was time Ted found someone. He'd been a bachelor too long.
It's high time you stopped rehearsing and just talked.
It was time to take a chance on love.

grammar.title: as...as...：和...一样... / not as...as...：不如...
grammar.explanation: as + 形容词/副词原级 + as = 同等程度；not as/so + 原级 + as = 不及。注意中间必须用原级！比较级核心考点。
examples: Ted was as nervous as a schoolboy.
The night was as magical as any fairy tale.
His line was not as clever as he thought.

grammar.title: Only + 状语放句首的倒装：只有当...才...
grammar.explanation: Only + 副词/介词短语/状语从句放句首时，主句用部分倒装（助动词提前）。表示强调条件。高级句式。
examples: Only when Robin smiled did Ted relax.
Only after the confession did he realize how cheesy he was.
Only on the rooftop did they speak the truth.

grammar.title: 比较级 + and + 比较级：越来越...
grammar.explanation: 单音节：adj-er and adj-er（colder and colder）；多音节：more and more + 原级（more and more nervous）。
examples: The night grew colder and colder.
Ted became more and more nervous.
His voice sounded less and less confident.

grammar.title: 情态动词 + be done：含情态的被动语态
grammar.explanation: 公式：情态动词 + be + 过去分词。can be done（可被做）、should be done（应被做）、must be done（必须被做）。
examples: Love can be found in the most unexpected places.

The story must be told exactly as it happened.

grammar.title: 祈使句和感叹句
grammar.explanation: 祈使句（命令/请求）：动词原形开头，否定加 Don't。例如 Slow down、Don't leave。感叹句：What + 名词 + 主谓！或 How + 形容词 + 主谓！。本集是复习，重点练习感叹句表达强烈情感：What a crazy plan it was! How desperate Ted had become!
examples: Don't leave the city, Robin.
What a desperate plan Ted came up with!
How romantic — and foolish — his rain chant was!

grammar.title: 现在完成时：have/has + 过去分词
grammar.explanation: 第四次接触现在完成时（前三次 EP07/08/15）。本集重点：现在完成时与一般过去时在上下文中的配合使用——过去时叙述具体事件，完成时总结影响或持续状态。例如：He did a rain chant (过去动作). He has never felt this desperate (至今仍如此)。
examples: Ted has stood on the roof many times, but never for this reason.
He has never tried a rain chant before.
Robin has planned to leave for the weekend.

grammar.title: 介词短语作状语：in/on/at + 地点
grammar.explanation: 第四次接触（前三次 EP08/15/17）。本集达到熟练掌握程度。重点：on the roof, at midnight, in the middle of the night 等表示时间和地点的介词搭配。这是让英语显得地道的关键细节。
examples: At midnight, Ted stood on the roof and performed a chant.
In the forecast, the sky was clear — his worst nightmare.
On that rooftop, everything had started and everything might end.

grammar.title: the more...the more...：越...越...
grammar.explanation: the + 比较级 (+ 主谓), the + 比较级 (+ 主谓)。前一分句是条件，后一分句是结果。可以省略主谓部分。写作中表达递进因果的经典结构。
examples: The longer Ted waited, the more nervous he became.
The more he rehearsed, the less natural he sounded.
The harder you try to control love, the more it slips away.

grammar.title: both...and... / either...or... / neither...nor...
grammar.explanation: 三个并列连词：(1) both A and B → 复数谓语；(2) either A or B → 就近一致；(3) neither A nor B → 就近一致。
examples: Both Ted and Marshall believed in true love.
She was both surprised and touched by his honesty.

grammar.title: must have done / can't have done：肯定/不可能（推测过去）
grammar.explanation: 对过去的推测。must have done = 肯定做了（90%把握）；can't/couldn't have done = 不可能做了。注意：表推测时 must 只用于肯定句，否定用 can't。
examples: Robin must have noticed the ring on Lily's finger.
Ted must have been incredibly nervous.
She can't have known what he was about to say.

grammar.title: Why not do...? / What about doing...?：提建议
grammar.explanation: Why not + 动词原形 = 强烈建议；What/How about + doing/noun = 温和建议。口语高频结构。
examples: Why not take a risk? Destiny never knocks twice.
What about having dinner before confessing forever?
Why not tell her how you really feel?

grammar.title: It is/was...that/who...：强调句
grammar.explanation: 强调句公式：It is/was + 被强调部分 + that/who + 其余。可强调主语、宾语、状语。与定语从句的区别：去掉 It is...that 后句子仍完整（强调句），否则是定语从句。
examples: It was Ted who blurted out the cheesiest line.
It was on the rooftop that everything changed.
It was destiny that brought them together.
